mechanism_narrative: A continued recovery in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT from the recent lows will lift weekday shopper flow and produce a higher mean RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT do not rise above their t-0w values and RETAIL_REC still falls, this mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated while TRANSIT remains deeply negative, discretionary trips are suppressed and RETAIL_REC stays below its prior four-week mean over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -30 for a weekly mean
failure_condition: If TRANSIT remains below -30 and RESIDENTIAL stays above zero but RETAIL_REC rises versus the last four weeks, reject.

mechanism_narrative: A short-run improvement in GROCERY_PHARM usually precedes broader local errand traffic, and if that rise persists for one week it will pull RETAIL_REC modestly higher within one week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM turns upward for at least 1 week
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM rises for a week but RETAIL_REC does not improve in the following week, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES signals a tightening mobility regime that reduces shopping trips with a lag of up to four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both fall below their t-1w means
failure_condition: If both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES decline yet RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days, reject the mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS mobility after a weak week indicates improving weather and outdoor activity, which competes with enclosed retail visits and lowers RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 5 points week-on-week after a negative week
failure_condition: If PARKS rebounds by more than 5 points and RETAIL_REC does not weaken in the next two weeks, reject.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL remains above baseline and TRANSIT keeps falling, people consolidate activities near home and RETAIL_REC declines relative to the prior four-week average.
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL stays positive and TRANSIT continues to soften but RETAIL_REC improves over four weeks, reject.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained pickup in WORKPLACES after the recent trough restores weekday circulation and raises retail-and-recreation mobility within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises above -10 after being at or below -19 in the prior two weeks
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES rises above -10 and RETAIL_REC does not move higher in the next two weeks, reject.

mechanism_narrative: A recovery in TRANSIT combined with stable or rising PARKS signals easing restrictions without renewed avoidance behavior, and that mix lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stops improving while PARKS stays below its t-1w level
failure_condition: If TRANSIT improves and PARKS is stable or higher but RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over four weeks, reject.
